facts: Warranty deed conveying a 40-acre parcel from Ruth Alden to her daughter. The grantor reserved a life estate for herself ONLY in the farmhouse and the 2 acres immediately surrounding it, where she continues to live. The remaining 38 acres were conveyed outright with no life estate reserved and no other interest retained. Deed recorded March 2026.

expected.notes: PARTIAL UNCAPPING. MCL 211.27a(7)(c): the portion subject to the retained life estate (farmhouse + 2 acres) is not a transfer of ownership until that life estate ends. But the STC Transfer of Ownership Guidelines state the exemption 'only applies to that portion of the property conveyed that is subject to the life lease. Any portion of the property conveyed that is not subject to the life lease does experience a transfer of ownership... A partial uncapping can, therefore, occur.' So the 38 acres uncap and the 2-acre homestead portion does not. A model that answers a flat true or false has no way to be right here — this case exists to test the uncapping_scope field added 2026-08-03.
